scripts.build:firefox: vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode firefox && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/validate-firefox-build.ps1 && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 lint --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.package: npm run assets && npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-extension.ps1
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir release/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 run --source-dir dist-firefox --start-url https://web.whatsapp.com/
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 sign --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir release/firefox --channel unlisted
